network.chainIdLocked: A network's chain ID cannot be changed — add a new network instead.
network.customCapabilities: Added networks get the same balances, transaction history, sends and dApp connections. What they do not get is the indexer behind the built-in chains, so NFT galleries and instant history are unavailable — the wallet falls back to scanning recent blocks. Confidential (FHE) balances exist only on Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia and Base Sepolia, where the coprocessor runs.
network.customNoFhe: This network doesn't support confidential (FHE) transactions — shielding will be unavailable on it. Regular sends, tokens and dApps work normally.

network.losesIndexer: Moving off the built-in provider disables the indexer for this network: NFTs and transaction history stop loading. Balances, sends and confidential features keep working.

privacy.howItWorksBody: Shielding moves tokens into an FHE-encrypted balance in a single transaction. Unshielding takes two: one to burn the encrypted balance and open a claim, and one to settle that claim once the burned amount has been decrypted with a proof the contract can verify. Confidential precision is capped at 6 decimals, so amounts are rounded down and any remainder is refunded.
